Thanks for calling your new on-hold voice

Every week I become the on hold voice of dozens of new companies. A friendly and sincere voice for your brand?
Your IVR should have a credible voice and one with experience. Thats exactly what you will get.


Please hold the line

On hold marketing can be a massive benefit to a company's telephone system. The importance of promoting your product or brand to your callers while on hold should not be underestimated.
On average callers to a business spend 33 seconds waiting to be connected. So, imagine what you could say to your callers during the time they are on hold or being transferred.


Your call is important to us

I work with the UK's biggest on hold companies daily and become the voice of dozens of new companies every week.
With a clear and concise delivery, promote your marketing message to callers while on hold or being connected.
Keeping the scripts short will have more impact.


We'll be with you in a moment

Phone prompts are actually very affordable. Starting at just £5 per short prompt. (minimum order fee applies)
Why not enhance your companies on hold messaging? Take the opportunity to highlight your latest promotion, let them know of events you will be hosting or attending or just wish your callers Merry Christmas and Happy New Year.
What ever you decide to promote, do it with a voice of experience.
